newsitem.title: USA: NFO Research buys MBL Group for $55 million.
newsitem.headline: NFO Research buys MBL Group for $55 million.

text.p: NFO Research Inc. said Monday it agreed to buy British market research firm MBL Group Plc in a deal valued at $55 million.

The Greenwich, Conn.-based research firm said it issued about 1.36 million new shares valued at about $32.3 million in exchange for all of MBL's outstanding stock. This increased NFO's oustanding shares to about 12 million from an average of about 10.5 million in the first quarter.
NFO also agreed to buy a portion of the shares of various MBL operating companies held by minority shareholder employees in 1997, and the rest within three years.
A company spokesman said NFO will have paid $47 million -- 1.5 million shares plus $11.1 million in cash -- by the end of the year.
He said NFO will pay an additional $8 million in three years, possibly more if the affiliates hit certain benchmarks.
NFO said it expected the deal to boost its 1997 earnings. It earned $1.95 million on revenues of about $30.1 million in the first quarter.
MBL, which has 27 offices in 17 countries, had about $45 million in revenues last year.
NFO's stock fell 75 cents to $22 on Nasdaq in late trading.
